## Paired Tests Delta Datasets
```{r, Soil Chemistry: Paired Tests Delta Datasets, cache=FALSE}

library(DT)

mean_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

sd_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(x)
}

mean_diff_ci <- function(diffs, conf.level = 0.95) {
  diffs <- diffs[!is.na(diffs)]
  n <- length(diffs)

  if (n < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      mean_diff = ifelse(n == 1, mean(diffs), NA_real_),
      diff_ci_low = NA_real_,
      diff_ci_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  md <- mean(diffs)
  se <- sd(diffs) / sqrt(n)
  tcrit <- qt(1 - (1 - conf.level) / 2, df = n - 1)

  tibble(
    mean_diff = md,
    diff_ci_low = md - tcrit * se,
    diff_ci_high = md + tcrit * se
  )
}

run_paired_test_suite <- function(df, outcome_vars) {

  purrr::map_dfr(outcome_vars, function(v) {

    dwide <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(carcass_id, years_since_death_f, dplyr::all_of(v)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(years_since_death_f %in% c("2y", "3y")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = years_since_death_f,
        values_from = dplyr::all_of(v)
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(`2y`, `3y`)

    n_pairs <- nrow(dwide)

    diffs <- if (n_pairs > 0) dwide$`3y` - dwide$`2y` else numeric(0)

    ci_tbl <- mean_diff_ci(diffs)

    out_base <- tibble(
      variable = v,
      n_pairs = n_pairs,

      mean_2y = if (n_pairs > 0) mean(dwide$`2y`, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd_2y   = if (n_pairs > 0) sd_or_na(dwide$`2y`) else NA_real_,

      mean_3y = if (n_pairs > 0) mean(dwide$`3y`, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd_3y   = if (n_pairs > 0) sd_or_na(dwide$`3y`) else NA_real_,

      mean_diff_3y_minus_2y = ci_tbl$mean_diff,
      diff_ci_low = ci_tbl$diff_ci_low,
      diff_ci_high = ci_tbl$diff_ci_high
    )

    if (n_pairs < 3) {
      return(
        out_base %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            normality_p = NA_real_,
            test_used   = NA_character_,
            statistic   = NA_real_,
            p           = NA_real_
          )
      )
    }

    shapiro_p <- if (sd(diffs, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      shapiro.test(diffs)$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    if (!is.na(shapiro_p) && shapiro_p > 0.05) {
      tt <- t.test(dwide$`3y`, dwide$`2y`, paired = TRUE)

      out_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          normality_p = shapiro_p,
          test_used   = "Paired t-test",
          statistic   = unname(tt$statistic),
          p           = tt$p.value
        )

    } else {
      wt <- wilcox.test(dwide$`3y`, dwide$`2y`, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)

      out_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          normality_p = shapiro_p,
          test_used   = "Wilcoxon signed-rank",
          statistic   = unname(wt$statistic),
          p           = wt$p.value
        )
    }
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_adj_BH, p)
}

paired_tests_abs <- run_paired_test_suite(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_abs
)

paired_tests_pct <- run_paired_test_suite(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_pct
)

DT::datatable(
  paired_tests_abs,
  options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
  caption = "Paired 2y vs 3y tests: absolute delta dataset"
)

DT::datatable(
  paired_tests_pct,
  options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
  caption = "Paired 2y vs 3y tests: percentage delta dataset"
)

```

## Paired Tests, 0m vs 15m within 2y
```{r, Soil Chemistry: Paired Tests, 0m vs 15m within 2y, cache=FALSE}

mean_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

run_paired_distance_tests_2y <- function(df, vars) {

  wide_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      time_since_death_years == 2,
      distance_lab %in% c("0m", "15m")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(carcass_id, distance_lab) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(vars), mean_or_na),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = distance_lab,
      values_from = dplyr::all_of(vars),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{distance_lab}"
    )

  purrr::map_dfr(vars, function(v) {

    v0  <- paste0(v, "_0m")
    v15 <- paste0(v, "_15m")

    dsub <- wide_df %>%
      dplyr::select(carcass_id, dplyr::all_of(c(v0, v15))) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()

    n_pairs <- nrow(dsub)

    diffs <- if (n_pairs > 0) dsub[[v0]] - dsub[[v15]] else numeric(0)

    ci_tbl <- mean_diff_ci(diffs)

    out_base <- tibble(
      variable = v,
      n_pairs = n_pairs,

      mean_0m = if (n_pairs > 0) mean(dsub[[v0]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd_0m   = if (n_pairs > 0) sd_or_na(dsub[[v0]]) else NA_real_,

      mean_15m = if (n_pairs > 0) mean(dsub[[v15]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd_15m   = if (n_pairs > 0) sd_or_na(dsub[[v15]]) else NA_real_,

      mean_diff_0m_minus_15m = ci_tbl$mean_diff,
      diff_ci_low = ci_tbl$diff_ci_low,
      diff_ci_high = ci_tbl$diff_ci_high
    )

    if (n_pairs < 3) {
      return(
        out_base %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            normality_p = NA_real_,
            test_used = NA_character_,
            statistic = NA_real_,
            p = NA_real_
          )
      )
    }

    shapiro_p <- if (sd(diffs, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      shapiro.test(diffs)$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    if (!is.na(shapiro_p) && shapiro_p > 0.05) {
      tt <- t.test(dsub[[v0]], dsub[[v15]], paired = TRUE)

      out_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          normality_p = shapiro_p,
          test_used = "Paired t-test",
          statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
          p = tt$p.value
        )

    } else {
      wt <- wilcox.test(dsub[[v0]], dsub[[v15]], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)

      out_base %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          normality_p = shapiro_p,
          test_used = "Wilcoxon signed-rank",
          statistic = unname(wt$statistic),
          p = wt$p.value
        )
    }
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_adj_BH, p)
}

paired_tests_2y_0m_vs_15m <- run_paired_distance_tests_2y(
  df = soil_chem_tr,
  vars = chem_vars_use
)
```

## GLMMs on Individual Delta Soil Properties
```{r, Soil Chemistry: GLMMs on Individual Delta Soil Properties, cache=FALSE}

library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

fit_delta_mixed_models <- function(df, outcome_vars) {

  model_list <- map(outcome_vars, function(v) {

    dsub <- df %>%
      filter(
        years_since_death_f %in% c("2y", "3y"),
        !is.na(.data[[v]]),
        !is.na(habitat_moist3),
        !is.na(carcass_id)
      ) %>%
      droplevels()

    if (nrow(dsub) < 6 || dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id) < 3) {
      return(list(
        fit = NULL,
        tidy = tibble(
          variable = v,
          term = NA_character_,
          estimate = NA_real_,
          std.error = NA_real_,
          statistic = NA_real_,
          p.value = NA_real_,
          conf.low = NA_real_,
          conf.high = NA_real_,
          n_obs = nrow(dsub),
          n_carcass = dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id),
          AIC = NA_real_
        )
      ))
    }

    form <- as.formula(
      paste0(v, " ~ years_since_death_f + habitat_moist3 + (1 | carcass_id)")
    )

    fit <- glmmTMB(
      formula = form,
      data = dsub,
      family = gaussian()
    )

    td <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "fixed",
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        variable = v,
        n_obs = nrow(dsub),
        n_carcass = dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id),
        AIC = AIC(fit)
      ) %>%
      select(variable, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
             conf.low, conf.high, n_obs, n_carcass, AIC)

    list(fit = fit, tidy = td)
  })

  names(model_list) <- outcome_vars

  tab <- bind_rows(map(model_list, "tidy"))

  list(
    models = model_list,
    table = tab
  )
}

abs_delta_model_fits <- fit_delta_mixed_models(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_abs
)

pct_delta_model_fits <- fit_delta_mixed_models(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_pct
)

abs_delta_model_fits$table
pct_delta_model_fits$table

knitr::kable(abs_delta_model_fits$table, digits = 3,
             caption = "Time and Habitat mixed models: absolute delta dataset")
knitr::kable(pct_delta_model_fits$table, digits = 3,
             caption = "Time and Habitat mixed models: percentage delta dataset")

### Habitat-Only Models ###

fit_delta_habitat_models <- function(df, outcome_vars) {

  model_list <- purrr::map(outcome_vars, function(v) {

    dsub <- df %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[v]]),
        !is.na(habitat_moist3),
        !is.na(carcass_id)
      ) %>%
      droplevels()

    if (nrow(dsub) < 6 || dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id) < 3) {
      return(list(
        fit = NULL,
        tidy = tibble::tibble(
          variable = v,
          term = NA_character_,
          estimate = NA_real_,
          std.error = NA_real_,
          statistic = NA_real_,
          p.value = NA_real_,
          conf.low = NA_real_,
          conf.high = NA_real_,
          n_obs = nrow(dsub),
          n_carcass = dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id),
          singular = NA
        )
      ))
    }

    form <- as.formula(
      paste0(v, " ~ habitat_moist3 + (1 | carcass_id)")
    )

    fit <- lmerTest::lmer(
      form,
      data = dsub,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = lme4::lmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
      )
    )

    td <- broom.mixed::tidy(
      fit,
      effects = "fixed",
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        variable = v,
        n_obs = nrow(dsub),
        n_carcass = dplyr::n_distinct(dsub$carcass_id),
        singular = lme4::isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
      ) %>%
      select(variable, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value,
             conf.low, conf.high, n_obs, n_carcass, singular)

    list(fit = fit, tidy = td)
  })

  names(model_list) <- outcome_vars

  list(
    models = model_list,
    table = bind_rows(purrr::map(model_list, "tidy"))
  )
}

abs_hab_models <- fit_delta_habitat_models(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_abs
)

pct_hab_models <- fit_delta_habitat_models(
  df = soil_delta_tsd,
  outcome_vars = delta_vars_pct
)

             caption = "Habitat-only mixed models: absolute delta dataset")
```

## LASSO and RIDGE Viability Models
### Data Setup
```{r, Soil Chemistry: Penalized Viability Models Setup, cache=FALSE}
library(glmmLasso)
library(hglm)

first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
}

mean_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

scale_safe <- function(x) {
  if (sum(!is.na(x)) < 2 || sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  } else {
    as.numeric(scale(x))
  }
}

# Rebuild raw soil chemistry viability dataset at the carcass-time-distance level
# keeps 0m and 15m as separate observations
soil_raw_viab <- soil_chem_tr %>%
  filter(
    time_since_death_years %in% c(2, 3),
    distance_lab %in% c("0m", "15m")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y_cult_row = case_when(
      culture_done == "Y" & culture_ac_pos == "Y" ~ 1L,
      culture_done == "Y" & culture_ac_pos != "Y" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    years_since_death_f = factor(
      paste0(time_since_death_years, "y"),
      levels = c("2y", "3y")
    ),
    carcass_size = case_when(
      as.character(carcass_size) %in% c("1", "Small") ~ "Small",
      as.character(carcass_size) %in% c("2", "Large") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    carcass_size = factor(carcass_size, levels = c("Small", "Large")),
    habitat_moist3 = factor(habitat_moist3, levels = c("Dry", "Medium", "Wet")),
    distance_lab = factor(distance_lab, levels = c("0m", "15m"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(carcass_id, time_since_death_years, years_since_death_f, distance_lab) %>%
  summarise(
    y_cult = if_else(
      any(!is.na(y_cult_row)),
      as.integer(any(y_cult_row == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    across(all_of(chem_vars_use), mean_or_na),
    habitat_moist3 = first_nonmissing(habitat_moist3),
    carcass_size = first_nonmissing(carcass_size),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    carcass_id = factor(carcass_id),
    habitat_moist3 = factor(habitat_moist3, levels = c("Dry", "Medium", "Wet")),
    carcass_size = factor(carcass_size, levels = c("Small", "Large")),
    years_since_death_f = factor(years_since_death_f, levels = c("2y", "3y")),
    distance_lab = factor(distance_lab, levels = c("0m", "15m"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(chem_vars_use), scale_safe, .names = "{.col}_pen_z")
  )

raw_chem_pen_vars <- paste0(chem_vars_use, "_pen_z")

# For delta datasets, use 0m viability as the outcome
viab_0m <- soil_raw_viab %>%
  filter(distance_lab == "0m") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    carcass_id,
    time_since_death_years,
    y_cult,
    carcass_size
  )

soil_delta_viab <- soil_delta_tsd %>%
  left_join(
    viab_0m,
    by = c("carcass_id", "time_since_death_years")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    carcass_id = factor(carcass_id),
    habitat_moist3 = factor(habitat_moist3, levels = c("Dry", "Medium", "Wet")),
    carcass_size = factor(carcass_size, levels = c("Small", "Large")),
    years_since_death_f = factor(years_since_death_f, levels = c("2y", "3y"))
  )

# Standardized absolute delta predictors
soil_delta_abs_viab <- soil_delta_viab %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(delta_vars_abs), scale_safe, .names = "{.col}_pen_z")
  )

delta_abs_pen_vars <- paste0(delta_vars_abs, "_pen_z")

# Standardized percentage delta predictors
soil_delta_pct_viab <- soil_delta_viab %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(delta_vars_pct), scale_safe, .names = "{.col}_pen_z")
  )

delta_pct_pen_vars <- paste0(delta_vars_pct, "_pen_z")

#Balance checks
check_viability_balance <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      dataset = label,
      n = n(),
      n_carcass = n_distinct(carcass_id),
      positives = sum(y_cult == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      negatives = sum(y_cult == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      missing_y = sum(is.na(y_cult))
    )
}

bind_rows(
  check_viability_balance(soil_raw_viab, "Raw standardized chemistry"),
  check_viability_balance(soil_delta_abs_viab, "Absolute delta chemistry"),
  check_viability_balance(soil_delta_pct_viab, "Percentage delta chemistry")
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Viability outcome balance for penalized regression datasets")
```

### Helper Functions
```{r, Soil Chemistry: Penalized Viability Models Helper Functions, cache=FALSE}
prep_pen_model_data <- function(df, outcome, predictors, group_var = "carcass_id") {

  df2 <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(outcome, group_var, predictors))) %>%
    drop_na()

  df2[[outcome]] <- as.integer(df2[[outcome]])
  df2[[group_var]] <- factor(df2[[group_var]])

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(df2[[outcome]]) < 2) {
    stop("Outcome has fewer than two classes after filtering.")
  }

  df2
}


fit_glmmLasso_grid <- function(df,
                               predictors,
                               outcome = "y_cult",
                               group_var = "carcass_id",
                               lambda_grid = c(10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)) {

  df2 <- prep_pen_model_data(
    df = df,
    outcome = outcome,
    predictors = predictors,
    group_var = group_var
  )

  fix_form <- stats::reformulate(predictors, response = outcome)

  rnd_form <- list(~ 1)
  names(rnd_form) <- group_var

  grid_fits <- purrr::map_dfr(lambda_grid, function(lam) {

    warning_messages <- character(0)

    fit <- withCallingHandlers(
      tryCatch(
        glmmLasso::glmmLasso(
          fix = fix_form,
          rnd = rnd_form,
          data = df2,
          lambda = lam,
          family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
          switch.NR = TRUE,
          final.re = FALSE,
          control = list(
            print.iter = FALSE,
            print.iter.final = FALSE,
            maxIter = 100,
            maxIter.final = 100,
            epsilon = 1e-4
          )
        ),
        error = function(e) e
      ),
      warning = function(w) {
        warning_messages <<- c(warning_messages, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    )

    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      tibble::tibble(
        lambda = lam,
        aic = NA_real_,
        bic = NA_real_,
        conv_step = NA_real_,
        n_selected = NA_integer_,
        convergence_warning = TRUE,
        warnings = conditionMessage(fit),
        fit = list(NULL)
      )
    } else {

      coefs <- as.numeric(fit$coefficients)
      names(coefs) <- names(fit$coefficients)

      tibble::tibble(
        lambda = lam,
        aic = as.numeric(fit$aic),
        bic = as.numeric(fit$bic),
        conv_step = as.numeric(fit$conv.step),
        n_selected = sum(abs(coefs[names(coefs) != "(Intercept)"]) > 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE),
        convergence_warning = any(grepl("did not converge|Algorithm did not converge|Fisher", warning_messages)),
        warnings = paste(unique(warning_messages), collapse = " | "),
        fit = list(fit)
      )
    }
  })

  valid_fits <- grid_fits %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$bic))

  if (nrow(valid_fits) == 0) {
    stop("No glmmLasso models fit successfully across the lambda grid.")
  }

  # Prefer models without convergence warnings; if all warned, choose lowest BIC anyway
  best_row <- valid_fits %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$convergence_warning, .data$bic) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  best_fit <- best_row$fit[[1]]

  coef_table <- tibble::tibble(
    term = names(best_fit$coefficients),
    estimate = as.numeric(best_fit$coefficients)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      selected = abs(.data$estimate) > 1e-6
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$selected), dplyr::desc(abs(.data$estimate)))

  list(
    data = df2,
    grid = grid_fits %>% dplyr::select(-.data$fit),
    best_lambda = best_row$lambda,
    best_fit = best_fit,
    coef_table = coef_table
  )
}


fit_hglm_ridge <- function(df,
                           predictors,
                           outcome = "y_cult",
                           group_var = "carcass_id") {

  df2 <- prep_pen_model_data(
    df = df,
    outcome = outcome,
    predictors = predictors,
    group_var = group_var
  )

  # Fixed intercept only
  X_fixed <- matrix(1, nrow = nrow(df2), ncol = 1)
  colnames(X_fixed) <- "(Intercept)"

  Z_carcass <- model.matrix(
    reformulate(group_var, intercept = FALSE),
    data = df2
  )

  Z_pred <- model.matrix(
    reformulate(predictors),
    data = df2
  )

  Z_pred <- Z_pred[, colnames(Z_pred) != "(Intercept)", drop = FALSE]

  # Remove zero-variance predictor columns after dummy expansion
  keep_cols <- apply(Z_pred, 2, function(z) sd(z, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  Z_pred <- Z_pred[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

  Z_all <- cbind(Z_carcass, Z_pred)

  fit <- hglm::hglm(
    X = X_fixed,
    y = df2[[outcome]],
    Z = Z_all,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    rand.family = list(
      gaussian(link = "identity"),
      gaussian(link = "identity")
    ),
    RandC = c(ncol(Z_carcass), ncol(Z_pred)),
    fix.disp = 1,
    method = "EQL1",
    maxit = 100,
    sparse = TRUE,
    calc.like = TRUE
  )

  ranef_vec <- as.numeric(fit$ranef)

  ridge_coef <- tibble(
    term = colnames(Z_pred),
    ridge_estimate = tail(ranef_vec, ncol(Z_pred))
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(ridge_estimate)))

  list(
    data = df2,
    fit = fit,
    coef_table = ridge_coef,
    convergence = fit$Converge,
    var_components = fit$varRanef
  )
}


summarise_penalized_results <- function(lasso_obj, ridge_obj, label) {

  lasso_tbl <- lasso_obj$coef_table %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = label,
      term,
      lasso_estimate = estimate,
      lasso_selected = selected
    )

  ridge_tbl <- ridge_obj$coef_table %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      ridge_estimate
    )

  full_join(lasso_tbl, ridge_tbl, by = "term") %>%
    arrange(desc(lasso_selected), desc(abs(ridge_estimate)))
}

```

```{r, Soil Chemistry: Ordination Plot, cache=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

pretty_chem_var <- function(x) {

    stringr::str_remove("^delta_") %>%

# PCoA ordination

pcoa_input <- soil_perm4_tsd %>%
  filter(!is.na(grp_tsd_dist)) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(chem_vars_z)) %>%
  mutate(
    years_since_death_f = factor(years_since_death_f, levels = c("2y", "3y")),
    distance_lab = factor(distance_lab, levels = c("0m", "15m")),
    grp_label = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(grp_tsd_dist),
      "2y_0m"  = "2y, 0 m",
      "2y_15m" = "2y, 15 m",
      "3y_0m"  = "3y, 0 m",
      "3y_15m" = "3y, 15 m"
    ),
    grp_label = factor(grp_label, levels = c("2y, 0 m", "2y, 15 m", "3y, 0 m", "3y, 15 m"))
  )

pcoa_dist <- vegan::vegdist(
  as.matrix(pcoa_input[, chem_vars_z]),
  method = "euclidean"
)

pcoa_fit <- cmdscale(
  pcoa_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE
)

pcoa_var <- 100 * pcoa_fit$eig[1:2] / sum(pcoa_fit$eig[pcoa_fit$eig > 0])

pcoa_scores <- pcoa_input %>%
  bind_cols(
    tibble(

perm_r2 <- tryCatch(res_perm4_tsd$permanova$R2[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)

p_pcoa <- ggplot(

      "; p = ", format.pval(perm_p, digits = 2)

    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_var[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_var[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Group",
    shape = "Distance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

supp_fig_soil_chem_pcoa <- p_pcoa +
```
